description: Floating-point numeric-edited PICTURE (the symbol E — a significand character-string and an exponent +9{1..4}, ISO §2023:13.18.40.4 GR13 b) - introduced 2002. LIVE (data-model design D21 / kb/Work PB66): category numeric-edited, class alphanumeric; the store normalizes the value to a leading-nonzero significand (§2023:14.6.8.4), overflow → EC-DATA-OVERFLOW + the pinned saturated image, underflow → zero (§2023:14.9.25.4 GR6 item 4); the de-editing MOVE, arithmetic GIVING with SIZE ERROR both ways, VALUE, level-88, HIGHEST/LOWEST-ALGEBRAIC. Below 2002 the gate names the edition (0900).
